The '''Laser Crate''' is a special time-limited crate. It first appears during the [[Laser]] campaign, but also reappears later to give you another chance at purchasing.

Cost: 60 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Raptor]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Stingray]] x6 (unique to this crate)
* [[Auroch]] x6
* [[Fury]] x6
* [[Flameburst Drone]] x12
* [[Shrike]] x12
* [[Dark Op Tank]] x12
* [[HADES]] x12
